caption:
3 to 5 doesn't mean 3/5.

A part-to-part ratio of 3:5 means 8 parts total, so red is 3/8 of the bag.

Follow @samsonsatprep for daily SAT tips.
tiktok_caption: A 3 to 5 ratio means red is 3/8, not 3/5.

youtube.title: SAT Ratio Trap: Part-to-Part vs Part-to-Whole
